serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Big Daddy: Do I even need to mention your bot? She can’t run away since you are her master. Who knows what she would do if she had any say in it? 
Big Daddy: But da Fisher is da one who makes it da most difficult for me to read her out. My bet is that she’s a crazy loner just like you! 
You: …
Big Daddy: I apologize for being so frank, but that’s da truth of da matter, I’m afraid. 
You: So what do you want me to do, exactly? Friendships come and go, there’s nothing I can do about it. Even rich people quarrel and fall out. 
Big Daddy: Oh, little one. Da point of it all is that I represent all da insecurities you have while interacting with your friends! 
Big Daddy: As long as I’m unbeaten you will always stutter your words while speaking with them. You will always be on edge around them. You won’t ever be able to truly enjoy your time with them, because always in da back of your mind there will be that thought that you don’t deserve it.
Big Daddy: I’m afraid our time together is running out time. I hope my explanation was satisfactory.
You: …
Big Daddy: Ready your rod.
In Big Daddy’s hand appeared a shiny, chromed fishing rod. It’s one of those concept models that are used to hype up everyone, but then they never go into mass production…
In comparison, the rod I’m holding is the same old Mrs. Fisher gave me… 
I tried to project something better into my hand, but it was no use. I have no control in this illusionary world. 
Big Daddy: We will start our duel on 3… 2… 1!
